runtime.title: Runtime Status
runtime.descriptionActive: Read-only snapshot of the background job engine, based on real job history (runtime_job_runs) - not in-process state, which is never meaningful on serverless hosting.
runtime.descriptionInactive: Read-only snapshot of the background job engine. No job of any kind has run in the last 26 hours - check that /api/cron/news-fetch and /api/cron/ai-enrichment are actually being triggered (Vercel Dashboard > Cron Jobs, or the schedule in vercel.json).
runtime.scheduleDescription: Configured intervals for the optional in-process scheduler (self-hosted deployments only - never runs on Vercel). Production relies on the external cron routes in vercel.json instead - see "Last Run" above for whether those are actually firing.
